description: Pre-registered A/B gates for a fine-tune vs stock XTTS-v2 (docs/recipe_design.md §6, phase 8). Fixed before any fine-tuned model is measured; changing them after seeing results defeats them. Margins are [E5] judgement, sized against run 2's seed noise (WER 95% CI half-width ~0.02, SECS ~0.02, UTMOS ~0.07).

gates.why: intelligibility on the eval voices must not regress
cloning of unseen eval voices must not regress (forgetting check)
no more empty, babbling or NaN outputs than stock

target_speaker_gate_template.how: For voice adaptation: run scripts/build_target_voices.py on your dataset (it holds out reference clips and writes dataset_train.jsonl to train on), measure both models with run_eval_baseline.py --voices target, then add this gate to 'gates' with the voice ids it printed (target_<speaker>) before running compare_ab.

gate.why: the fine-tune must sound more like the target speaker than stock cloning does
